name: Reslynn Legacy
source: This is a story about Eos and Kaila. At a young age, both of them have experienced a trauma. The male protagonist has lost his mother in a car-crash and the female protagonist has lost her father to cancer. The widow, Kaylee Cuoco, and widower, Fernando Resylnn, met at grief counselling and married only one year after they met. The protagonists are very different, yet rely on each other due to their shared grief. Thanks to a great opportunity for Fernando they now move to a new city. The legacy starts with their story​.
translation: 这是一个关于伊欧斯和凯拉的故事。年幼时，两人都经历过创伤。男主因车祸失去了母亲，女主因癌症失去了父亲。寡妇凯莉·措科 (Kaylee Cuoco) 和鳏夫费尔南多·雷斯林 (Fernando Resylnn) 在悲伤咨询中相识，仅一年后就结婚了。主角们性格各异，但却因共同的悲伤而相互依赖。感谢费尔南多的绝佳机会，他们现在搬到了一个新城市。遗产始于他们的故事。
